narrative.overview: The Modern Academy aesthetic combines the structured efficiency of a digital tool with the clean, direct visual language of contemporary educational platforms.
keyCharacteristics: Generous whitespace to prevent cognitive overload for teachers.
A restrained palette using Academic Maroon as a focal point.
dos: Do use Montserrat for all functional/interactive text.
Do maintain a minimum of 16px padding inside all management containers.
donts: Don't use heavy box-shadows; prefer subtle borders or background tints.
Don't overcrowd the interface; prioritize teacher efficiency through whitespace.
